const x=$json;
return [{json:{...x,state_contract:{

 stage:x.state_after?.stage??"NEW",

 selected_product:x.state_after?.selected_product??null,
 selected_variant:x.state_after?.selected_variant??null,
 cart_id:x.state_after?.cart_id??null,
 turn_count:x.state_after?.turn_count??0,
 language:x.state_after?.language??null,
 script:x.state_after?.script??null,
 register:x.state_after?.register??null,
 escalation:x.state_after?.escalation??{required:false},
 persisted:x.state_persistence?.status==="persisted"
}}}];
